When metadata.name is unset, the create path (client.create / POST) sends any incoming resourceVersion, e.g. k8s: { resourceVersion: '0' } from an import or copy, and saving a new dashboard fails. This brings the bug back; the deletion must run before the branch, as in v1.ts.
Deletes the regression test that checks the create path (POST) sends no resourceVersion and does not call PUT. Without it, nothing catches the bug brought back in v2.ts.

outdated.reason: The current implementation consistently excludes minimum height from row-track sizing. getAutoRowsTemplate accepts only rowHeight, fillScreen and hasFitContent; creation, updateAutoRows and deserialization all use that signature. Corrected body: Grid autoRows derives from configured row height, fill-screen mode and fit-content presence. Minimum height is applied to fit panels through getFitMinHeightInPixels in AutoGridItemRenderer, so changing it does not require recomputing autoRows. Deserialization still enables fit growth only when auto-height panels are enabled and the layout or a child opts into fit content.

The implemented sizing policy contradicts the cached shrinking-track rule: getAutoRowsTemplate explicitly states 'Row tracks always floor at the configured row height' and returns `minmax(${rowHeightPixels}px, ${maxRowHeightValue})`. The updated deserialization assertion expects 'minmax(320px, max-content)' for a custom 100px panel minimum. Corrected body: Auto-grid row tracks retain the configured row-height floor, including fit-content rows. Fit panels receive their own minimum through the panel chrome. Matched non-fit cells rely on the shared track floor; unmatched non-fit cells receive an explicit row height. Fit-panel minimums do not lower the shared track floor.
